meta.denominator_note: correctness aggregates computed over the 12 items with an actual grounded_v3 correction; the 6 fallthroughs are counted and assessed for recall gap but excluded from correctness %.

grading_rubric.explanation_correct: grammatical justification actually correct; minimal 'la forme correcte est X' with no invented rule = True; fabricated/wrong rule = False
grading_rubric.correction_form_right: the corrected surface form the arm outputs is grammatically right
grading_rubric.concise: restates only the erroneous phrase (or phrase+immediate object), 2-4 sentences

items.learner_error: j'ai acheter -> j'ai acheté (infinitive used where past participle required after avoir)

tuned.notes: Rule 'après avoir, participe passé acheté' is correct; quotes erroneous phrase + object.

grounded_v3.notes: Correct: 'après l'auxiliaire avoir, participe passé, pas l'infinitif'. Token-tight restatement.

tuned.notes: Fabricated rule 'après je, avoir prend -é' is nonsense; form acheté is right.
'devant elle, que devient qu' correct minimal elision rule.
Wrong diagnosis 'on utilise elle, pas elle est' — the error is elision, not a redundant verb; form is right.

items.learner_error: que j'ai collecté -> collectées (accord du participe passé avec COD antéposé 'les données')

tuned.notes: Tuned gave off-topic encouragement + follow-up question; it MISSED the participle-agreement error entirely.

grounded_v3.notes: Strong catch: collectées, rule 'accord en genre et nombre avec le COD placé avant' correct (données fem. pl., que = COD antéposé).

tuned.notes: Tuned 'corrected' a non-error lexical item (mot de réveil -> mot d'appel) and missed the real grammar error; restated span is the wrong clause.
Wrong rule: 'après décider on utilise le subjonctif' — d'utiliser is an elided infinitive, not a subjunctive; form is right.
Misleading: 'décider se construit avec d' et non de' — décider always governs 'de', which merely elides to d' before a vowel; the stated rule is wrong as a general claim. Form right.

Explanation invokes agreement 'accorde avec légumes' — wrong: with avoir there is no agreement with a COD placed AFTER (would give achetés). Right form by coincidence. Restates the whole sentence incl. irrelevant first clause.
Fabricated rule 'après hier, le verbe prend le participe passé'; restates the whole sentence.

items.learner_error: j'ai définir -> j'ai défini (infinitive where past participle required)

tuned.notes: Correct rule 'après avoir, participe passé défini'; but restates the whole clause incl. irrelevant 'j'ai fait un sprint de quatre semaines'.

grounded_v3.notes: Correct. Crucially did NOT touch 'le planning' — the v2 false positive is gone.

tuned.notes: Tuned silently assumed 'défini' (misquotes learner) and instead did a lexical swap descope -> 'fonctionnalités à exclure'; it did not surface/justify the actual grammar error. Output text is grammatical, so form counted right; explanation off-target.

grounded_v3.notes: Correct participe-passé template; 'le planning' left untouched (no false positive).
